answer: Vouch-slot bond: each agent holds three slots per epoch, pledging a 120-credit anchor bond per slot. Each slot bears a saffron seal naming its sponsor. A public trellis lists every edge, exposing rented slots. A fake vouched identity burns its 70-credit bond, slashes the anchor bond, and bars its sponsor for six epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 4,547,500 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 prize; the k-th fake pays 52+9(k-1). One honest agent spends 52 once.
